references.text: The burnt offering was to be an unblemished animal, as described here for the Nazirite.
The sin offering was to be a female animal without defect, like the one-year-old ewe mentioned in Numbers 6:14.
The peace offering (shelamim) is mentioned here, the same type of sacrifice as the ram in the Nazirite vow.
One-year-old, unblemished lambs were used for sacrifices, as specified for the Nazirite.
The Passover lamb was to be a one-year-old, unblemished animal, corresponding to the requirement for the Nazirite's offering.
All offerings to the Lord had to be without defect (tamim), as specified for the Nazirite's three sacrifices.
Christ offered himself without blemish to God, fulfilling the Old Testament requirement for unblemished sacrifices.
Christ is described as a lamb without blemish or spot, fulfilling the image of the unblemished sacrificial animals.
